text:
Hello departures team,
The desk staff noted a concern about route planning earlier this week.

I need everyone to treat companion animal routing as a safety matter, not a convenience item. Several files showed rushed handoffs, and that creates avoidable stress for the animals and for the crew. Please review each booking carefully, confirm the welfare notes, and make sure any special handling needs are visible before departure. If a case looks unclear, escalate it at once instead of guessing.

<<FACT F034>> We also need consistent checks on crate placement, ventilation, and quiet transfer paths, because small lapses can quickly affect animal comfort. The welfare coordinator must be looped in whenever there is uncertainty about species mix, behavior, or cabin limits. Do not rely on verbal assumptions from earlier shifts, and do not let a rushed schedule override the documented care plan.

<<FACT F051>> Make sure every handoff is confirmed by name and role, and keep the communication brief but complete. If a traveler arrives with a pet that is unsettled, pause the process and bring in the trained staff member assigned to the desk. We cannot afford another missed detail, especially when there is pressure at the gate.

Please correct this standard across the Companion Animal Travel Desk and report any unresolved case directly. The next shift needs clear records and steady judgment.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
